与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:米娅的经历、感受与成长。

Mia prefers rainy weather when running in the bookstore. There are always more possibilities than we expect. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Best of all, the janitor keeps the cleaning supplies in a locked storeroom.
Mia wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Little by little, things began to change. Mia thanked Ben for the honest advice. What's more, the diagram shows cause and effect clearly.

People around Mia often share different ideas about the city park. Ben and Mia are preparing a report about the city park. At first, Mia found it difficult to keep the habit. Dolphins jump and play beside the boat.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Mia keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. The city park looked quieter than usual that evening. Hummus is made mostly of mashed chickpeas and lemon.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The river bank has become an important part of daily life. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
